calculator_results.title: History persists after activity restart and can restore an expression
calculator_results.expected: History shows 1+1 = 2 and restores the expression
calculator_results.actual: history=History · 7 | Clear | Close history | = 0.3 | 200+10% | 27th Oct, 07:13 | = 220 | √(9) | = 3 | sin(30) | = 0.5 | 1+1 | 27th Oct, 07:14 | = 2; restored=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 1+1 | = 2
calculator_results.comment: The history entry survived process restart and restored its expression.

calculator_results.title: Grouped history card restores and re-evaluates without Error
calculator_results.expected: History card re-evaluates to 123457 without Error
calculator_results.comment: The grouped expression was restored and evaluated successfully; display commas did not contaminate the calculation.

calculator_results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
calculator_results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

calculator_results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
calculator_results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.

user_results.title: Copy then paste the selected digits
user_results.actual: Copy was not offered by the selection menu; clipboard round-trip was not attempted.
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Cut a held number and type into the gap
user_results.expected: Selection is removed; next digit is 7
user_results.actual: Cut was not offered by the selection menu.
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Clear a held selection with AC
user_results.expected: Held text and selection menu both clear
user_results.actual: No selection menu was exposed; AC-while-selected could not be attempted.

user_results.title: Tap inside a number and insert a digit
user_results.expected: 9 is inserted at the caret, not appended
user_results.comment: A tap within the visible number inserted 9 before the final character instead of appending at the end.

user_results.title: Open the three-dot menu

limits: Direct APK evidence comes from Android 14/API 34 emulator UI actions, screenshots and hierarchy dumps.
Feature-page opens are smoke checks, not proof that every deep workflow works.
Ad checks scan visible text on sampled screens; they are not a network or whole-app ad audit.
Source-CI runs are reported separately from direct APK results.
